mentions.name: Loracle
mentions.description: This app records tabletop RPG sessions on Discord or accepts uploaded raw session audio, then transcribes the sessions, takes notes, and builds a knowledge graph of the campaign's fantasy world. It generates a rich personal wiki and session notes covering NPCs, quests, and characters that users can interact with, and it can bootstrap a campaign wiki from plain-text session notes so mid-campaign groups have a base of NPCs, quests, and characters for future audio-based sessions.
mentions.problem: Players forget key details of their collective D&D story between sessions, like where the party left off after a month or who a particular NPC was.
mentions.audience: D&D and tabletop RPG players who need to recall details of their ongoing campaign
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm trying to build the best TTRPG chronicler: https://loracle.app

Everyone who plays D&D has experienced the moment where they forget key details about the collective story they're building. From 'hey it's been a month, where are we?' to 'wait who was this crazy npc again?', ai is excellent at transcribing, notetaking and building a knowledge graph of your fantasy world.
